edit.description: Early soft control; redistribute ratio budget to later nodes; same M2 reward
edit.interpolation: smoothstep; phase is normalized over observed score nodes; no extrapolation
edit.normalization: dose is normalized over actual score nodes to a mean of one

failure_modes: Affinity: final predicted target affinity does not improve or degrades versus the constant-dose incumbent despite verified dose delivery, indicating the early-suppression hypothesis is wrong.
Path coverage: rare-path coverage or early compatible path formation is lost under W1_early_soft, since suppressing early dose may starve early exploration.

Dose delivery: realized per-seed dose deviates from the requested schedule (flow magnitude, gradient cancellation, caps, clash backtracking), so the recipe is not actually executed as specified; equal sum(dt*w) is only a ratio budget.

Falsifier for H001/H002: a refit on the same support showing no sign reversal in the local rate, or a stable accepted polynomial with no strong sign conflicts, would remove the justification for any time-varying dose.
Scope: only one coordinate proxy curve was read; cross-coordinate consistency is unobserved, so the recipe may not generalize beyond landmark_00_local_dx.
rationale: Analyst H001/H002, grounded in the actual landmark_00_local_dx curve (E4bbe368c52deda38) over the observed window [0.0,0.49] (E0857891f4effbfe1), report a non-stationary contrast: strongly negative local rate early (first_rate_z≈-17.5) reversing to positive late (last_rate_z≈8.1) with a small whole-window level contrast. This justifies a time-varying dose policy rather than a stationary target. Among the registered dose recipes, W1_early_soft (dose [0.35,1,1.65] over knots [0,0.5,1]) is the offered choice that suppresses guidance during the early negative-rate phase and redistributes the ratio budget to later nodes where the rate is positive, matching the observed sign reversal. It preserves the M2 reward geometry (delta, teachers, mixture, temperatures, frozen eta) and only changes the registered dose factor. W3_early_strong_control is the opposite time-order control and would amplify guidance exactly where the observed rate is negative; W2_middle_peak does not follow the observed early/late structure.
